ABOUT_PARAGRAPH_2: I like understanding how things work. Curiosity pushes me to dig deeper into every subject that interests me, while keeping up with AI news that lets me put more ideas into practice.

PROJECT_NOITAMAP_SUMMARY: A live interactive map for Noita that follows your run and rebuilds the world map for any seed.
PROJECT_NOITAMAP_ROLE_1: The project started as a fork of noitamap, which only showed pre-captured map tiles; I set out to rebuild Noita's map generation for any seed.
PROJECT_NOITAMAP_ROLE_2: I got familiar with Ghidra and used REA's MCP server (Reverse Engineer Anything) to reconstruct functions from the game's binary.
PROJECT_NOITAMAP_ROLE_3: This is my biggest project so far; it was important to understand and identify the AI's needs and to give a growing project a viable structure, so its results stay relevant.
PROJECT_NOITAMAP_ROLE_4: A Node bridge connects the Noita mod to the frontend over WebSocket, displaying the player's position in real time.
PROJECT_NOITAMAP_COVER_ALT: Screenshot of the Noita Livemap viewer showing the world map and seed panel

PROJECT_KASA_ROLE_2: Split the UI into reusable React components (gallery, collapse, cards)
PROJECT_KASA_ROLE_3: Set up client-side routing with React Router, including a 404 page
PROJECT_KASA_ROLE_4: Styled everything in Sass, responsive from mobile to desktop
PROJECT_KASA_COVER_ALT: Preview of the Kasa rental listing app

PROJECT_MON_VIEUX_GRIMOIRE_ROLE_1: Designed and built the REST API the provided React front end consumes
PROJECT_MON_VIEUX_GRIMOIRE_ROLE_2: Implemented authentication with hashed passwords and JSON Web Tokens
PROJECT_MON_VIEUX_GRIMOIRE_ROLE_3: Wrote the book CRUD and a rating system with one vote per user
PROJECT_MON_VIEUX_GRIMOIRE_ROLE_4: Optimized uploaded images on the server with Sharp

PROJECT_SITE_SOPHIE_BLUEL_SUMMARY: An architect's portfolio website in vanilla JavaScript, no framework.

PROJECT_POKEMON_FARMER_SUMMARY: A bot that hunts shiny Pokémon on the GBA games, running encounters automatically.
PROJECT_POKEMON_FARMER_ROLE_1: We use live screenshots and masks to analyze the game state and decide which sequences of actions to perform. This avoids reading the game's RAM (which would not work on a different version of the game).
PROJECT_POKEMON_FARMER_ROLE_2: The first encounter saves the Pokémon's appearance; later encounters with the same Pokémon compare the colors, allowing shiny detection.
PROJECT_POKEMON_FARMER_ROLE_3: This project is a textbook case of trial and error: development -> test -> logging the errors -> test -> repeat.
PROJECT_POKEMON_FARMER_COVER_ALT: Placeholder preview for the Pokémon Farmer project
PROJECT_PROJECTM_SUMMARY: A self-made Netflix-style streaming app that plays the media from my NAS.
PROJECT_PROJECTM_ROLE_1: This project got me familiar with scrapers. Fetching posters, titles and release dates from IMDb/TMDB was a great exercise.
PROJECT_PROJECTM_ROLE_2: Many films are not relevant, so I had to decide how to select them, using ratings, categories and where the content comes from.
PROJECT_PROJECTM_ROLE_3: After many failed attempts at fetching subtitles from subtitles.com, I wrote a script that extracts the subtitles from the files and uploads them to the NAS, making them automatically available.
PROJECT_PROJECTM_ROLE_4: To make the app fully functional, users are authenticated with Supabase, giving them access to a wishlist
PROJECT_PROJECTM_COVER_ALT: Screenshot of the MaxFlix catalog grid with movie and show posters
